audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart reads Urgot for all seven rows, contradicting the already-audited mirror (aatrox__urgot) which has Level 6 as Skill and both item rows as Aatrox.
audit.why: The mirror was audited first; the two directions must agree. Urgot's early lead is real (51.18% WR, 1860 games) but World Ender's healing plus Bloodthirster/Death's Dance flips the late rows.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 through 4-5 stay Urgot; Level 6 becomes Skill; First item and 2+ items become Aatrox. win[4..6] proposed in the same pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes cite a first-back Bami's/Frostfire on Urgot and credit Corrosive Charge with shred; no real cooldown numbers anywhere.
audit.why: Urgot builds Black Cleaver/Steelcaps, not Bami's. Corrosive Charge does physical damage and a slow, no shred. Concrete cooldowns (Q 14s rank 1, R 120s rank 1 on Aatrox; Disdain 16s rank 1 on Urgot) make the spike advice actionable.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal moved to the first back; World Ender's 120s and Darkin Blade's 14s written into cooldowns/mid; Disdain's 16s named as the window to protect.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] claims Disdain shoves him onto a 'shrapnel detonation' for a 'full magic burst'; whys[2]/mid call Aatrox's kit a 'revolver combo'; the Deathbringer Stance auto-reset tell is absent entirely.
audit.why: Riot's text: Corrosive Charge deals physical damage and slows — there is no magic burst. Aatrox swings a greatsword; 'revolver' is fabricated. Deathbringer Stance is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up (not an ability cast) is the cue to disengage.
audit.corrected: Q described as physical damage plus slow; Disdain described as a shielded flip that buys the 16s window; greatsword naming restored; the Deathbringer Stance reset tell written into spikes[2].

audit.why: Live patch 26.15; nothing in the brief indicates a recent move in this matchup.

edits.before: Fear Beyond Death online — at 25% HP Aatrox is simply dead. Trade him to half, then the chain threat decides everything.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death online at 25% HP, but World Ender's 120s heal buys him the same window. Even fight: land R low or don't commit.

edits.before: Black Cleaver stacks instantly with W — your shred turns even tanky answers soft. Shove and force Aatrox to trade into the spike.
edits.after: His first item plus World Ender healing outgrows your shred window. Shove, take plates, and refuse extended fights near his R.

edits.before: Sterak's + Cleaver makes your W-trades unloseable head-on. Aatrox must dodge E forever or find a jungler — punish the first mistake with R.
edits.after: Two items in, his drain wins any long fight. Trade only behind Disdain's 16s window and side-lane where he cannot chain Q sweetspots into you.

edits.before: Level 3 Q-into-E out-trades his revolver sweetspots cleanly.
edits.after: Level 3 Q-into-Disdain out-trades his greatsword swings.

edits.before: Through 4-5 your shred and slows keep him from landing full Q combos.
edits.after: Through 4-5 your Q slow keeps him from landing full Darkin Blade combos.

edits.before: At 6 your R execute flips any all-in he starts after burning World Ender heal.
edits.after: At 6 your R execute answers him, but World Ender's heal evens the all-in.

edits.before: First item shred neuters his % healing while your Q chunks him.
edits.after: First item, his drain outgrows your shred without Grievous.

edits.before: Late-game tank-shred and R execute keep you ahead of his sustain.
edits.after: Late, his max-HP drain beats your shred outside R execute range.

edits.before: With Q into E you out-trade every Aatrox all-in: land Corrosive Charge on the ground under him, then Disdain shove him back onto the shrapnel detonation so he eats the full magic burst before his Q1 sweetspots ever line up.
edits.after: With Q into E you out-trade every Aatrox all-in: land Corrosive Charge under him for the physical hit and the slow, then Disdain flips him away — his Q sweetspots need you close, and that 16s Disdain window is what you protect.

edits.before: A first-back Bami's/Frostfire plus Corrosive Charge's shred means you chunk him every time he steps up to last-hit; his Q3 knockup is his only real trade tool and you can W-slow-walk out of it.
edits.after: A first-back Executioner's Calling plus Q poke chunks him every time he steps up to last-hit; his Deathbringer Stance auto-reset is the wind-up tell — step out on that animation, not on an ability cast.

edits.before: Bloodthirster/Death's Dance make Aatrox scary in extended fights, but his healing is % max-HP based, so build early tank shred (Chempunk/Serpent's) and you neuter his sustain while your Q keeps executing him.
edits.after: Bloodthirster/Death's Dance make Aatrox scary in extended fights, and his healing scales off your max health, so buy Grievous Wounds early (Chempunk/Executioner's) and hold R for the execute, never for poke.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay firmly yours because Q-into-E out-damages his revolver combo, and once you hit 6 your R execute punishes any all-in he commits to after his heal.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay yours because Q-into-Disdain out-damages his greatsword combo, but at 6 World Ender's 120s heal evens the all-in — commit only while that ult is down.

edits.before: Even into items you hold the edge: build a shred item to kneecap his % healing, keep Corrosive Charge on cooldown for the magic burst, and your R keeps deleting him from every skirmish.
edits.after: Into items he holds the edge in long fights: buy Grievous Wounds early to cut his drain, keep Corrosive Charge up for the slow, and take fights only where R can finish him.

edits.before: - Aatrox World Ender: matchup-defining — His drain ramps in long fights. Poke him low first. Track it before every engage. - Aatrox The Darkin Blade: Three swings; the outer-edge sweetspot knocks up and deals heavy damage. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Aatrox World Ender: matchup-defining — 120s at rank 1 and his drain ramps in long fights. Only commit while it is down. - Aatrox The Darkin Blade: 14s at rank 1, three swings; the outer-edge sweetspot knocks up. Sidestep the edge.
